mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and increasing the present value of S&P 500 earnings, leading to positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and housing market strength, which amplifies corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of joint-upward instances, or the interaction effect is not significant in a multivariate regression (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing activity and broadening economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains above 3.0%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy regime that suppresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant in a regression (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a rising unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and labor market deterioration, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant in a multivariate model (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% combined with stagnant payroll growth signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.5 and PAYEMS growth < 0.5% in t-1mo
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) during a period of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) indicates stagflationary conditions where supply constraints and inflation coexist, increasing equity risk premiums and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in less than 65% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
